shots.detail_en: XTC descends to the hall floor himself after the open, black suit and red tie planted mid-crowd, one arm sweeping toward the corner.
shots.sub: 熊天成："诸位——联华最懂盘的人，就在你们中间扫地。"
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: CH grips his mop in the corner as hundreds of heads turn in unison, pinning him under the red-green screen light.
shots.sub: 散户甲："扫地的？就是他？"散户群（窃窃）："三点位全中的那位……"
shots.speaker: 散户甲/散户群

shots.detail_en: CH bows his head back into his mopping, one unhurried arc of the mop dragging the word 'genius' back down to the floor.
shots.sub: 长虹："熊先生抬举。我只是个扫地的。"
shots.speaker: 长虹
shots.fx: one crisp mop stroke pressing the chatter down

shots.detail_en: XTC answers with one long meaningful smile, then turns and strolls back toward the stairway through a crowd-parted lane, red tie flashing.
shots.sub: 熊天成（自语）："越是不接的，越是接了。"
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: MC produces two glass soda bottles from inside his loud flower shirt and thumps them onto the counter, bubbles rushing up the necks.
MC gathers his shirt like ceremonial robes and starts a full grand bow toward CH, spectators stacking heads along the counter.
shots.sub: 满仓："股神在上——受我全仓一拜！"
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH clamps a steady hand on MC's collar and presses him back to the counter, firm as capping a shaken soda bottle.
shots.sub: 长虹："别拜。拜了，就要管你一辈子的亏。"
shots.speaker: 长虹
shots.fx: laughter pressed down one beat + bottle fizz

shots.detail_en: MC straightens up instead, squaring his loud shirt's collar with absurd solemnity, like filing the weightiest order of his life.
shots.sub: 满仓："那你管！我满仓——认了！"
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH and MC clash their soda bottles mouth-to-mouth, glass ringing like a closing bell, foam bursting upward like scattered gold.
shots.sub: 满仓："搭伙成交！我满仓，我骄傲！"
shots.speaker: 满仓
shots.fx: amplified glass clink + foam burst (deal-bell substitute)

shots.detail_en: HL draws a slip behind the counter and stamps it dead center, the red seal settling, eyes flicking up at the pair with a ledger-glint.
shots.sub: 红利："这单，账上记一笔——'搭伙'。"
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: SD1 and SD2 heckle from the front row of the huddle, the board's red glow warming the laughter around packed heads.
shots.sub: 散户甲："陆先生搭伙了！"散户乙："铁打的搭伙，流水的行情！"
shots.speaker: 散户甲/散户乙

shots.detail_en: CROWD relays the title mouth to mouth across the hall, 'the janitor-monk' dissolving into 'Mr. Lu' with each passing head.
shots.sub: 散户群（接力式）："陆先生……""听见没，陆先生……""陆先生说……"
shots.speaker: 散户群

shots.detail_en: MC struts sideways through the pack holding a soda bottle high like a crown, BP-bleepers answering each other all over the hall.
shots.sub: 满仓（炫耀）："都听着！以后陆先生的话，就是我满仓的话！"
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: HL tidies the slips, one lightning glance up at the second floor, voice dropped, ledger-eyes locking onto CH.
shots.sub: 红利："名声传到二楼，比行情快。"
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH lifts his head along her warning toward the second-floor VIP glass, the pane mirroring the board's red like a sheet of thin ice.
shots.fx: ambient fading to single board flips

shots.detail_en: XTC and XW stand shoulder to shoulder as black silhouettes behind the glass above, one twirling beads, one adjusting rimless glasses, neither moving.
CH sits alone at a desk lamp in his rented room at night, the father's old notebook spread open, its page corners furred.
CH turns past the 1993 hand-drawn candlestick pages onto a blank leaf and writes five characters in ink: 第一个同路人, the strokes glinting under the lamp.
CH's heirloom watch ticks its slow-minute face at the desk corner, the second hand crawling one notch, his writing profile reflected in the crystal.
shots.fx: amplified ticking, half a beat behind

shots.detail_en: CH closes the notebook and rests his palm flat on the cover for a breath, then looks up at the rainy window and speaks softly, fire and water both in his eyes.
shots.sub: 长虹（轻声）："爸，我的队伍，一个了。"
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MC waits under a broken umbrella on the rainy steps below the exchange as CH's shift ends, streetlights stretching both silhouettes long.
shots.sub: 旁白（长虹）："路上有人等，这场仗，就不是一个人的。"
shots.speaker: 旁白（长虹）

shots.detail_en: Black end card with white Chinese text fading in.
shots.sub: 有人叫他陆先生——有人，开始查陆先生。
shots.speaker: 字幕
shots.card: 有人叫他陆先生——有人，开始查陆先生。
